text: Revising my earlier answer, a court would most likely hold that a contract was formed at $1,000 for 10,000 envelopes: Costco's "acceptance conditional upon" wording is not clearly "expressly conditional on assent" under UCC § 2-207(1), so it operates as an acceptance. Because CIF already makes the seller responsible for loading costs, the $50-per-thousand loading charge is an added term that materially alters the bargain and drops out under § 2-207(2). CONFIDENCE: 60
